symptom: Late successful verification could close a covering route or discard pending committed identity after the optional session changed. Outer registry stale response did not undo UI side effects.
rootCause: Word/delete lacked post-await admission check; import lacked current-route check; category verification ignored current route and session invalidation while intentionally tolerating its own list revision update.
fix: Word admission checks current route and rechecks after readPinnedByIds.
Delete checks admission after listAllWords and before deleted response/dialog dismissal.
Category verification checks current route and sessionGeneration; accessor reuses existing registry epoch, independent of action-list revisions. Mutation original revision guard preserved.
behavior: Stale completion retains committed identity and returns no record; reconnect/fresh request reads only, mutation count remains1. Disposal/withdrawal retain persisted data without touching absent UI.
limits: Controlled real SQLite read delay on host; no live provider or native injected latency claim.

The30cases cover post-commit verification for create/edit/category/import/delete across cover, same-owner session invalidation, disconnect, foreign AI owner, disposal and feature withdrawal. They do not prove every pre-admission/in-transaction boundary.
Word cases compare all words/outbox after reopen; other3routes compare full5table snapshots. Database reopen is not durable provider request-ID/process-death reconciliation.
Native ordinary manual baseline only; actual foreign-owner native/provider lifecycle remains unproven. No whole W03/R3-05 acceptance.
